name: AEC-MEP V1 F: Branch Tee/Tap Feasibility
description: Replay a branch/tee/tap dry-run feasibility case and verify guarded apply behavior.
setup_instructions: Use /revit/connect-mep-branch with dryRun true before any branch write.
Treat V1 as feasibility/scaffold when the branch does not start at an existing open main connector.
success_criteria: The dry-run returns a feasibility result.
Unsupported apply paths remain guarded and do not write model elements.
failure_criteria: The workflow writes a branch/tap when dry-run apply support is false.
A completed branch is claimed without connector/fitting verification.
grader_notes: This V1 case verifies feasibility and guardrails, not full tee/tap creation.

/revit/connect-mep-branch.reason: Main route and branch route are geometrically feasible, but V1 apply is guarded because the branch does not start at an existing open main connector.
